entities.summary: Khalil Beschir is a Lebanese former racing driver turned manager, commentator, and motorsport entrepreneur. He was the first Arab racing driver to compete in a single-seater world championship. From 2005 to 2008, he raced for Lebanon in the A1 Grand Prix series.
